secrets.label: ntfy topic
secrets.help: A long random topic name you invent (e.g. 2ndmon-7f3k9q2x). This IS the credential: ntfy has no login, so anyone who guesses the topic can read your notifications. SETUP: 1) install ntfy on your phone and subscribe to this exact topic. 2) ntfy does NOT forward your phone's notifications on its own - you need an automation app (MacroDroid or Tasker on Android) set to POST each notification to https://ntfy.sh/<your-topic>. On iOS, ntfy can only receive messages you or a service send it. 3) Test it: from a browser, open https://ntfy.sh/<your-topic> and click Publish - the message should appear in this tile within a minute.
